title: SVE author 1.0 shared leaf and reference definitions
$comment: Closed author node fragments for numeric expressions, conditions, object and recipient queries, event/history narrowing, capture, LKI operands and payment/dice reads. These registered variants share one recursive graph; they are not complete author entry, E/C/Sel or execution admission contracts. Scope, units, source authority and capabilities require C1/D0 validation.
